description: The try function gives the dynamic value for an unknown value after a failing argument
notes: The README says try evaluates its arguments until one produces a result without any errors, and gives that result, so try(nope, u) with u an unknown number would be an unknown number. hashicorp/hcl's try (ext/tryfunc/tryfunc.go) gives the dynamic value for any successful value that isn't wholly known, because it can't tell whether the argument will still succeed once its value is known.
